'''Guyvar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith officer]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Guyvar first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', but he was one of a number of elements that were not completed in the final release of the game. Guyvar was intended to participate in a mission dealing with visiting [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] dignitaries and the enslaved Chevin working under the captain, but the mission&mdash;along with several other missions involving characters in or around Guyvar's camp&mdash;were cut from the game.
